name: Tsitsikamma Lodge and Spa
address: n 2 National Road , 8 km East of Storms river Bridge, Stormsrivier, 6308, South Africa
description_short: Lodge restaurant serving hearty country fare in the heart of Tsitsikamma's indigenous forest.
description_long:
Nestled 8km east of the iconic Storms River Bridge along the N2, Tsitsikamma Lodge and Spa's restaurant offers a welcome respite for travellers exploring the Garden Route. The dining room overlooks indigenous forest, creating a tranquil setting whether you're stopping for lunch or settling in for dinner after a day on the trails.

The menu leans into South African comfort food with generous portions that satisfy hungry hikers and road-trippers alike. Expect classic grills, fresh line fish when available, and hearty pub-style dishes that hit the spot after outdoor adventures. The atmosphere is relaxed and unpretentious – think lodge dining rather than fine dining, with friendly service that makes solo travellers and families equally comfortable.

The location puts you right in Tsitsikamma territory, minutes from the Suspension Bridge and countless hiking trails. It's the kind of place where you can fuel up before tackling the Otter Trail or unwind with a cold beer after exploring the coastal paths. The spa facilities add to the appeal for those needing post-adventure recovery.
